title: TaskStatusInfo
description: The TaskStatusInfo data type describes the status for a specific task

orderId.description: The unique identifier of the signing order

taskId.description: The unique identifier of the task (is omitted if task status is “deleted”)

clientReference.description: The client reference that was registered with this task, if any

clientStatus.description: The last client status that was registered on this task, if any

documents.description: A list with status info for each of the documents in the task, provided the task status is COMPLETED

rejectReason.description: A reason for rejecting the task, given by the end user

id.description: The unique identifier of the original document in the signing order

formOutputParam.description: Form parameters that were either prefilled and/or filled in by the end user

DocumentStatus.description: The DocumentStatus data type describes a document as part of the given task

name.description: The name of the parameter. This must match the name of the parameter in the form template.

FormParam.description: The FormParam data type describes a specific parameter in a form
